record.question: When the patient's information from a record is given to an insurance company attorney or governmental agency. It is ________ of the medical record.
record.explanation: Answer C: release of information. Disclosing information from a patient record to an insurer, attorney, or government agency is release of information, subject to authorization and applicable law. Reference: https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/privacy/guidance/disclosures-for-law-enforcement-purposes/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
